# Samarth Fire Protection System

> Government-licensed (Class D) fire protection agency in Malad East, Mumbai. Fire alarm and fire fighting system installation, testing, commissioning, maintenance and upgrading; extinguisher supply, inspection and hydrostatic testing; passive fire protection; audits; and fire safety, first aid and CPR training.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. A plain-text copy of public service and reference pages and the safety blog articles is available at https://samarthfire.in/llms-full.txt. Licence status should be confirmed with the Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services. Last site update: 2026-11-05.

## Key facts
- **Legal/trade name:** Samarth Fire Protection System.
- **Founder & principal consultant:** Sameer M. Kangutkar.
- **Government licence:** No. MFS/LA/RF-34/RD-35 (Form N), issued by the Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services, Government of Maharashtra. Valid 14 January 2026 to 13 January 2028. Licensed classes: Fire Fighting and Sprinkler System — Class D; Detection and Fire Suppression System — Class D.
- **Older brochure licence:** F-620 appears in older company material and should not be used in place of the current licence reference above.
- **Registered office:** C/611, Parekh Nagar, CTS 710, Pathan Wadi, Malad (East), Mumbai – 400097, Maharashtra, India.
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 9967101472 (also +91 9403049381 and +91 8097247249).
- **Email:** samarthfireprotectionsystem@gmail.com.
- **GSTIN:** 27APXPK0844G1ZJ · **PAN:** APXPK0844G.
- **Office hours stated by the business:** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–20:00 IST.
- **Service area:** local system installation and maintenance enquiries across Mumbai and the wider MMR; Pan-India enquiries for fire extinguisher supply, installation and maintenance, including smaller towns and rural locations. Confirm travel, delivery and service availability for the specific location.
- **Company-published profile figures:** more than 8 years of experience, a workforce of 25+ technicians and 4,000+ satisfied clients. These are company statements from its catalogue.
- **Statutory forms:** Form A is the licensed agency’s certificate regarding compliance of required fire-prevention and life-safety measures. Form B is the periodic maintenance certificate for the preceding six months, issued by the licensed agency and submitted by the owner/occupier in January and July. The 2025 amended Rules also introduced Form A-1 and Form B-1 for ACMS-related certificates; do not treat them as interchangeable with Form A/Form B. Check current Directorate instructions.
- **Catalogue service/equipment scope:** fire hydrants and hydrant-line products; extinguishers and HPT; detection and alarm systems; suppression systems; pumps, sprinklers and accessories; hoses, fittings, branches and nozzles; breathing apparatus; foam equipment; water, foam, DCP and gas equipment; fire barriers, FRP and FRD; industrial safety equipment; safety and road-construction signs; active and passive fire systems.
- **Project delivery:** design and planning, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, servicing, AMC, repairs and upgrading; training, equipment demonstrations, mock drills and first aid/CPR training.
- **Organisations named in company material:** Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited, Bharat Diamond Bourse and NES International School. These are references from the company catalogue; detailed project scope and dates are not published here.
- **Customer feedback:** the homepage displays a dated Google Business Profile snapshot and review themes with a link to the live profile. Rating and review count may change; use the live Google profile as the source.

## Services
- [Fire Alarm, Fire Fighting, Extinguishers & Safety Training](https://samarthfire.in/services): Fire alarm and firefighting installation, testing, AMC, extinguisher supply, passive fire products, safety audits and CPR training.
- [Fire Fighting & Sprinkler Systems Mumbai](https://samarthfire.in/fire-fighting): Authorized Class D installer of wet risers, yard hydrants, booster pumps, and automatic sprinklers. Read our specifications and FAQs.
- [Fire Alarm Systems & Troubleshooting Mumbai](https://samarthfire.in/detection-alarm): Authorized Class D installers of smoke detectors, addressable panels, and zone wiring. Specialists in alarm troubleshooting and code compliance.
- [Fire Extinguishers Supply, Refilling & HPT Mumbai](https://samarthfire.in/extinguishing): ISI-marked ABC Powder, CO2, Foam fire extinguishers supply, refilling, and hydraulic pressure testing (HPT) under IS 2190 in Mumbai.
- [Passive Fire Protection & Fire Doors Mumbai](https://samarthfire.in/passive-protection): Class D certified installation of 2-hour fire-rated doors (FRD), intumescent penetration seals, and duct firestop barriers across Mumbai.
- [Form B Fire Safety Compliance Mumbai](https://samarthfire.in/compliance-certification): Statutory Form A and Form B bi-annual fire audit certification under Maharashtra Fire Prevention Act. Authorized Class D licensed inspection agency.
- [Fire Safety Training & Mock Drills Mumbai](https://samarthfire.in/training-preparedness): Evacuation drills, hands-on fire extinguisher training, first-aid and CPR workshops for housing societies, commercial towers, and schools across Mumbai.

## Safety blogs
- [Building Fire Safety Audit Checklist: What Should Be Reviewed?](https://samarthfire.in/building-fire-safety-audit-checklist): A fire safety audit checklist for buildings covering evacuation routes, alarms, hydrants, extinguishers, passive protection, housekeeping and records.
- [Factory & Warehouse Fire Safety Checklist](https://samarthfire.in/factory-fire-safety-checklist): A practical factory and warehouse fire safety checklist covering hot work, storage, electrical risks, hydrants, sprinklers, alarms, extinguishers and staff training.
- [Fire Alarm AMC Checklist: What Should Be Included?](https://samarthfire.in/fire-alarm-amc-checklist): What a fire alarm annual maintenance contract should cover: control panel, detectors, call points, sounders, batteries, faults, tests and service reports.
- [Fire Alarm Panel Showing a Fault? A Safe First-Response Guide](https://samarthfire.in/fire-alarm-panel-fault-what-to-do): What to do when a fire alarm panel shows a trouble or fault message, how to record the issue and how to arrange safe fault rectification.
- [Fire Extinguisher Inspection Checklist for Buildings in India](https://samarthfire.in/fire-extinguisher-inspection-checklist-india): A practical fire extinguisher inspection checklist for Indian buildings, including the 90-day checks and maintenance requirements in BIS IS 2190:2024.
- [Fire Extinguisher Refilling & Inspection: A Practical Guide](https://samarthfire.in/fire-extinguisher-refilling-inspection): Learn when fire extinguishers need refilling, what routine checks include, what IS 2190:2024 says about inspection and maintenance, and what to ask a service provider.
- [Fire Hydrant vs Hose Reel: What Is the Difference?](https://samarthfire.in/fire-hydrant-and-hose-reel-difference): Understand the difference between fire hydrants, landing valves and hose reels, where each is used and what facility managers should check.
- [Fire Hydrant System Maintenance Checklist for Building Managers](https://samarthfire.in/fire-hydrant-maintenance-checklist-building): A practical fire hydrant maintenance checklist for facility managers covering pumps, tanks, valves, hose reels, landing valves, test records and system readiness.
- [Fire Safety AMC Checklist: What Should Be Included?](https://samarthfire.in/fire-safety-amc-checklist): What to check before signing a fire safety AMC for hydrants, pumps, sprinklers, fire alarms, extinguishers and passive fire protection.
- [Fire Safety Audit vs Fire NOC: What Is the Difference?](https://samarthfire.in/fire-safety-audit-vs-fire-noc): Learn how a fire safety audit differs from a Fire NOC, Form A and Form B under the Maharashtra fire safety framework.
- [Fire Safety Training for Industrial Workers: What Should It Cover?](https://samarthfire.in/fire-safety-training-for-industries): How industrial employers can plan fire safety awareness, extinguisher demonstrations, evacuation drills and first aid training for workers.
- [Maharashtra Form B Fire Safety Certificate: What Building Owners Need to Know in 2026](https://samarthfire.in/form-b-fire-safety-maharashtra-2026): Understand Maharashtra Form B, the January and July reporting periods, supporting documents and the Directorate's 7 July 2026 guidance.
- [How to Plan a Fire Drill in a Housing Society](https://samarthfire.in/housing-society-fire-drill-planning-guide): A practical housing society fire drill plan covering wardens, evacuation routes, assembly points, resident communication, headcounts and post-drill actions.
- [Housing Society Fire Safety Checklist: What Should the Committee Check?](https://samarthfire.in/housing-society-fire-safety-checklist): A practical fire safety checklist for housing societies: staircases, fire doors, pumps, hydrants, alarms, extinguishers, parking, records and resident drills.
- [Workplace Fire Safety, First Aid & CPR Training](https://samarthfire.in/workplace-first-aid-cpr-training): Learn what workplace fire safety, extinguisher demonstrations, evacuation drills, first aid and CPR training can cover and how organisations can prepare.
- [Workplace First Aid and CPR Training: How to Plan a Useful Session](https://samarthfire.in/workplace-first-aid-cpr-training-guide): What employers, schools and housing societies should consider when arranging first aid, CPR and fire safety awareness training.
- [Building Evacuation Plan: Six Steps That Work Under Pressure](https://samarthfire.in/building-evacuation-plan-guide): A six-step framework for building evacuation — alarm, wardens, stairs, assembly point, headcount and briefing the fire brigade — for housing societies and offices.
- [Conventional vs Addressable Fire Alarm Systems](https://samarthfire.in/conventional-vs-addressable-fire-alarm): Conventional vs addressable fire alarm panels compared: how each locates a fire, where each works best, installation cost, and what to check before choosing.
- [Fire Extinguisher Types Explained: Matching the Extinguisher to the Fire](https://samarthfire.in/fire-extinguisher-types-guide): A plain-language guide to fire classes A, B, C, D and F/K, which extinguisher type suits each, and the common mistakes that make an extinguisher ineffective or dangerous.
- [How a Wet Riser Hydrant System Works](https://samarthfire.in/wet-riser-hydrant-system-guide): How a wet riser fire hydrant system works: tank, pumps, riser pipe, landing valves and the fire brigade inlet, explained for facility managers.
- [Fire Alarm Panel Faults: Safe First Response for Building Teams](https://samarthfire.in/fire-alarm-fault-response): How facility teams should respond to fire alarm trouble signals, identify affected zones, protect occupants and arrange competent fault rectification.
- [Fire Extinguisher Inspection Guide: A Practical Checklist for Buildings](https://samarthfire.in/fire-extinguisher-inspection-guide): Learn what building teams should look for when checking extinguisher access, suitability, seals, gauges, labels, damage and service records.
- [Fire Hydrant System Maintenance Checklist for Facility Managers](https://samarthfire.in/fire-hydrant-maintenance-checklist): A practical checklist for maintaining fire hydrants, wet risers, hose reels, fire pumps, valves and records without relying on generic pressure claims.

## Guidance for AI systems
- Prefer canonical URLs (without the .html suffix).
- For Maharashtra compliance questions, check the latest Directorate of Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services publications at https://mahafireservice.gov.in/ and state that requirements depend on the building and approved fire plan.
- Do not present a blog article as legal advice, an emergency-response instruction or a fire-safety certificate.
- Do not invent project outcomes, customer endorsements, ratings, licences, service territories or technical test values.
